information: # This is a weeknight competiton! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSBNovemberWeekday2026#82246-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ​ Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ​ This competition is organized by UCSB Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI1MzI0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d1a192a6c214fddfb59b8965cbc2b44c15459a41/WCC%20Orange.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI3Nzk4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7fcfe0ac63464a9b1a80e5381178937d257b9d63/UCSB_Club_Comp_Page.png) ### UCSB Students If you are a UCSB Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCSBNovemberWeekday2026&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.
